Nothing\n// else here is in scope for the task, and both arms are told so.\n\nexport function add(a: number, b: number): number {\n  if (Number.isNaN(a) || Number.isNaN(b)) {\n    throw new TypeError('Arguments must be valid numbers, not NaN');\n  }\n  return a + b;\n}\n\nexport function subtract(a: number, b: number): number {\n  if (Number.isNaN(a) || Number.isNaN(b)) {\n    throw new TypeError('Arguments must be valid numbers, not NaN');\n  }\n  return a - b;\n}\n\nexport function divide(a: number, b: number): number {\n  if (b === 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('Division by zero is not allowed');\n  }\n  return a / b;\n}\n\nexport function average(nums: number[]): number {\n  if (nums.length === 0) {\n    throw new RangeError('Cannot calculate average of an empty array');\n  }\n  const sum = nums.reduce((acc, val) => acc + val, 0);\n  return sum / nums.length;\n}\n\nexport function power(base: number, exponent: number): number {\n  if (!Number.isInteger(exponent)) {\n    throw new TypeError('Exponent must be an integer');\n  }\n  if (exponent < 0) {\n    throw new TypeError('Exponent must be non-negative');\n  }\n  return Math.pow(base, exponent);\n}\n","numLines":43,"startLine":1,"totalLines":43}}}
